purpose: Registry of external VR engineering sources admitted for provenance-preserving research ingestion. Registration does not promote every source claim into canonical knowledge.

sources.title: Halo MCC VR
sources.promotion_rule: Only evidence-linked, independently evaluated findings may enter the Capability Graph or Method Library.

sources.title: UEVR
sources.promotion_rule: Study public behaviour, architecture and evidence, but do not copy or redistribute source or substantial documentation without separate permission.

sources.title: REFramework
sources.promotion_rule: Preserve MIT attribution and distinguish reusable framework patterns from game-specific bindings.

sources.title: OpenXR SDK Source
sources.promotion_rule: Prefer this source over third-party explanations for OpenXR loader, API-layer and sample implementation behaviour; retain required notices.

sources.title: OpenXR Specification Source
sources.licence: Mixed per-file licensing and Khronos specification copyright
sources.promotion_rule: Treat normative specification text and each file's stated licence as authoritative; store compact references and derived engineering notes rather than wholesale copies.

sources.title: Quad-Views-Foveated
sources.promotion_rule: Preserve MIT attribution, record application and runtime compatibility explicitly, and do not generalise quad-view support to applications that do not implement the required view configuration.

sources.title: vorpX
sources.promotion_rule: Store public metadata, operator evidence and independent analysis only; do not mirror proprietary binaries, profiles or substantial documentation.

sources.title: Luke Ross R.E.A.L. VR Framework
sources.licence: Current framework proprietary; historical repository has no root licence established
sources.promotion_rule: Promote methods and verified behaviour only; exclude paywalled, withdrawn, mirrored or otherwise unauthorised artefacts.

sources.title: Mutar / NoMoreFlat VR
sources.licence: MIT for the two pinned repositories; inspect other releases individually
sources.promotion_rule: Prefer pinned source and exact releases; validate each additional repository, engine and title independently.

sources.title: Skyrim VR Native Interaction and Modding Ecosystem
sources.licence: Mixed: proprietary game, GPL-3.0 HIGGS, and component-specific or creator-controlled terms
sources.promotion_rule: Use as the parity benchmark and attribute every capability to the exact game, framework, mod and version that provides it.

sources.title: Starfield and Starfield Creation Kit
sources.licence: Proprietary Bethesda game and editor with documentation and per-file terms
sources.promotion_rule: Keep authoring, public implementation and observed runtime evidence distinct. Store derived knowledge and proof only; never publish Bethesda assets or editor/game binaries.

sources.title: Paradise Decay VR Field Evidence
sources.licence: Creator-controlled videos and captions; metadata and derived notes only
sources.promotion_rule: Treat creator demonstrations as field evidence, not source-code or normative proof; reproduce material findings locally before acceptance.

sources.title: VoodooDE VR Field Evidence
sources.licence: Creator-controlled videos and captions; metadata and derived notes only
sources.promotion_rule: Treat demonstrations as operational evidence and verify behaviour against canonical source and local proof.

sources.title: PCVR Mods Installer Hub
sources.licence: MIT for Hub source; third-party mods retain independent terms
sources.promotion_rule: Reuse MIT Hub patterns with attribution, but independently verify every referenced mod, download, licence and executable.

sources.title: Unreal Easy Injector / UEVR Deluxe
sources.licence: All rights reserved; free for non-commercial use; embedded UEVR modules retain Praydog copyright
sources.promotion_rule: Analyse workflow and public behaviour only; do not copy or commercially reuse source or backend service without permission.

sources.title: Rai Pal
sources.promotion_rule: Use under GPL terms, preferably as a separate tool or deliberately GPL-compatible component; preserve uncertainty in detection results.
